title: Preflight-result channel schema (schema_version 1)
description: Machine-readable handoff file between the driver, preflight contract initialiser, and unattended admission bar. The path discriminator enforces exactly which sections each run path requires and forbids.

path.description: Identifies the run path that produced this result. The driver independently computes the expected path and rejects disagreement.

contract.description: The fully resolved frozen verification contract, written by the preflight initialiser on fresh runs with a coverage block and/or a finalized verification.yaml (#242 C2; #239 C3). Composes up to five sections: the flat C1 coverage fields (present as a unit — command implies the rest), `verifiers` (the deterministic set), `conformance` (evaluator + criteria — the app it exercises lives at `app` since C3), `app` (the ONE application both runtime consumers share), and `visual` (the harness contract). At least one verification section must be present, and `app` is REQUIRED — possibly null, for the blockless attended park — whenever `conformance` or `visual` is.

verifiers.description: #242 C2: every kind: deterministic verifier of the finalized verification.yaml, frozen at preflight. The landing gate EXECUTES each frozen test command (bounded by timeout_sec); a verifier is never inferred green from the generic test.command.

conformance.description: #242 C2: the frozen conformance contract — present iff the finalized artifact maps any FR to runtime_conformance. evaluator/timeout_sec are BOTH null when the config block is absent (attended blockless: the gate parks provider_unavailable; unattended cannot reach this state, admission refuses) or both configured. #239 C3 (T5): the APPLICATION it exercises is NOT declared here — it moved to contract.app, with `interface` resolved there, so ONE lifecycle serves both the evaluator and the visual harness. Every bound is a positive INTEGER of seconds — the gate enforces them with integer shell arithmetic, and the automation schema, the config validator, and validate_contract_json all agree.

allOf.description: The evaluator side is all-null (blockless attended) or all-configured — a half-frozen evaluator is invalid.

app.description: #239 C3 (T5), relocated from contract.conformance.app: the application under test, frozen ONCE and shared by BOTH runtime consumers — the conformance evaluator and the visual harness. There is no second app object anywhere. `interface` is RESOLVED at freeze (app.interface, else ready.url): it is what the evaluator receives, what the launch-binding proof must find SILENT before launch, and what readiness must find answering after. null on the blockless attended path, where the gate parks rather than launching.

visual.description: #239 C3 (T5): the frozen visual contract the landing gate reads. command/artifact/url/timeout_sec are ALL null when the artifact maps kind: visual but the config carries no verification.visual — the CRITERIA are frozen either way, so the requirement stays unskippable and the gate parks — or ALL configured. skip_is_failure is frozen as a BOOLEAN (defaulting TRUE) so the gate never decides a default at judgement time, and `url` is the frozen browser base, never derived from readiness or the evaluator interface.

allOf.description: The command side is all-null (a visual mapping with no config block) or all-configured — a half-frozen visual contract is invalid.

baseline.description: Captured baseline coverage. null means greenfield (no prior coverage to baseline against). An empty baseline object ({}) is invalid — the contract initialiser must capture real numbers or write null.

allOf.description: #239 C3 FR-10: the app key is REQUIRED (null only for the blockless attended park) whenever a runtime consumer — conformance or visual — is frozen. A configured consumer with no app key would bypass the shared lifecycle entirely.

#239 C3 FR-10, value-level: app may be null ONLY while every frozen runtime consumer is itself all-null (blockless attended). A CONFIGURED conformance evaluator beside app:null would leave the evaluator nothing to exercise; the gate keys the lifecycle on app != null, so it would silently skip launch/binding/readiness.
#239 C3 FR-10, value-level: a CONFIGURED visual command beside app:null would leave the harness no running application to point a browser at.

The C1 coverage fields travel as a unit with their cross-field rules: ANY coverage field present requires the FULL required set and applies all four rules below; a contract carrying only C2 sections (verifiers/conformance) is exempt (#242 round-2 finding 3 — the executable validator scopes its C1 rules the same way).
At least one floor (min_line_pct or min_branch_pct) must be present.
preset_id and preset_sha256 must both be strings (with values) or both be null — mismatched pairing is invalid.
Regression rules: max_regression_pct is forbidden when baseline is null (greenfield) and required when baseline is non-null (brownfield).

Brownfield baseline completeness: every floored metric must have a captured baseline value to regress from (FR-4) — a floor whose metric the baseline lacks would be silently exempt from the no-regression promise.

admission.description: Admission bar accounting written by unattended admission (FR-9). Attended profiles never run admission and must never carry this section.

oneOf.description: fresh-attended-block — contract initialisation only; no admission (attended profiles never run it).
fresh-unattended-block — admission bar runs first, then contract initialisation; both sections required.
fresh-unattended-noblock — admission bar only; contract FORBIDDEN (no block → no contract to freeze).
resume-unattended-block — admission bar only; contract FORBIDDEN (resume must not overwrite frozen policy — the prohibition is what makes it checkable by the driver).
